exposure: patients who did not receive intrathecal fentanyl
time from spinal placement to procedure end
cohort: Patients who underwent cesarean delivery with spinal anesthesia as the initial anesthetic technique
finding: Patients who did not receive intrathecal fentanyl had increased odds of conversion to general anesthesia or administration of systemic anesthetic adjunct administration.
mod_finding: This study focuses on the use of intrathecal fentanyl during cesarean deliveries performed under spinal anesthesia.
